children.text:
To use cheats, press Ctrl+Bksp in-game. A text box will appear in the center of the screen. Enter one of the following commands (all lowercase):

- combine — opens the spell combination screen (if available)
- destroy — destroys all enemies on screen
- god — toggles god mode
- hit — deals damage to the player
- level — levels up the player
- restart — restarts the level
